children: Insider trades were seen across a slew of major companies this week, including at Big Tech firms like Apple and Meta. The following transactions took place between November 16 and November 20.
Apple
director Arthur Levinson sold 90,000 shares at about $352-$353 each for a total value of $31.77M. The transaction represented about 2.40% of his holdings, leaving him with 3.67M shares.
Meta Platforms
Chief Financial Officer Susan Li sold 2,127 shares at $641.69 each for $1.36M. The sale accounted for about 8.68% of her indirect holdings, leaving her with 22,382 shares.
Coca-Cola
Executive Vice President Manuel Arroyo sold 57,581 shares at $99.40 each for $5.72M. The transaction represented about 36.65% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 99,514 shares.
Merck
EVP and President of Merck Animal Health Richard DeLuca sold 58,185 shares at $148.01 each for around $8.61M. The sale accounted for about 33.74% of his holdings, leaving him with 114,291 shares.
Duke Energy

EVP and Chief Power Grid Operations Officer Scott Batson sold 15,126 shares at $129.25 each for $1.96M. The transaction represented about 45.16% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 18,365 shares.
Boeing
director Akhil Johri purchased 3,000 shares at $166.69 each for $500,067, increasing his direct holdings to 3,150 shares.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company

VP Lee Lee-Chung purchased 5,000 shares at $60.57 each for $302,850, increasing his holdings to 318,514 shares. Meanwhile, director Ursula Burns purchased 1,375 shares at $363.67 each for $500,039, increasing her holdings to 4,992 shares.
DraftKings
director Matthew Kalish purchased 55,000 shares at $18.22 each for $1M, increasing his holdings to 5.69M shares.
3D Systems
director Jim Kever purchased 400,000 shares at $1.43 each for $572,000, increasing his holdings to 1.16M shares.
Corteva
CEO Luther Kissam IV purchased 32,292 shares at $9.30 each for $300,312, increasing his holdings to 185,379 shares.
